scope: Draft plan review only; no runtime or formal execution. Existing claims remain conditional on their original assumptions and do not preserve the overridden revision 6 live-path policy.

findings.location: contract.md initialization and runtime-test-plan IM01-IM03, IM30
findings.problem: Copying in bounded chunks does not bound the total bytes copied. A replaced, concurrently growing, special, or oversized source can keep the copy running or consume arbitrary memfd/system memory before the post-copy size check. Resource exhaustion is required to deny but that alone does not provide a bounded operation or preserve service resources.
findings.required_fix: Require a regular-file source if compatible with the intended deployment; enforce a hard total copy limit derived from the immutable expected size, detect early EOF and one-byte excess, bound initialization time, and close every source/image/temporary descriptor on all failures before publishing state. Do not trust fstat alone under mutation. Add oversized, growing, truncated, nonregular and timeout/failure-cleanup tests, including no partially published cache/gate state.

notes: The explicit revision 7 restart-only disk check is a genuine policy change; the seven abstract conditional propositions and retained model claims do not prove current-path tamper detection.

The execution object, descriptor lifetime, prlimit/procfs inheritance, seal checks and dynamic libraries remain runtime and platform trust obligations; the planned tests must establish only their finite observed behavior.
